candidates.source_name: 1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) / Book of Parables (1 Enoch 37-71)
candidates.source_attribution: 1 Enoch 62:5, trans. R.H. Charles (1912). PD. Cf. Mt 25:31.
candidates.draft_body:
1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Book of Parables (1 Enoch 37-71) (c. 100 BC)

'And one portion of them shall look on the other, and they shall be terrified, and they shall be downcast of countenance, and pain shall seize them, when they see that Son of Man sitting on the throne of his glory' — the eschatological enthronement of the Son of Man with the kings of the earth before him in judgment. The verse provides the canonical Jewish basis for Matthew 25:31 ('When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory'). Tewahedo Christology preserves this inter-textual continuity: Matthew's enthroned Son of Man is the same as 1 Enoch's; the Gospels presuppose the Mäṣḥafä Hēnok's developed figure.
